title: Calendar on a phone (and Split View / Slide Over): each day's agenda lists the timed events, then every routine, review, Money and goal item in no order — a 07:00 routine sits under a 19:20 lesson and 'All day' comes last
detail: Copy account, iphone (402) and slide (375), #/calendar Agenda, week of 23 Nov. Measured from the rendered rows (eval of .k-cal-arow-when in order, twice, at iphone and at slide): Thursday reads 09:00, 10:15, 13:00, 17:30, 19:20, then 07:00, 22:00, 16:00, 07:00, 16:30, 22:00 (the 'From Routines' rows: routine windows and the three review slots); Saturday ends 22:00, 18:00, 15:30, 09:00, 15:00, 22:30, All day. The row's own time column shows the true start, so the day reads out of order; on the copy every day of the week has 4-6 derived rows after its events (12 routines, 3 review slots a day). The desktop week grid places the same items correctly by time. Should: one list per day sorted by start, all-day first, as eventsOn() already sorts the events.
rootCause: js/modules/calpage.js:823-861 agendaRows — builds the events (sorted by eventsOn, js/modules/calendar.js:470) and then pushes assignments, reminders and derived items (routine/review windows carry d.time, js/modules/calendar.js:608 and 615) in source order, never sorting the combined rows by time. The order predates Phase 1 (moved from calendar.js into calpage.js by e4b97462, 1F).
fix: In agendaRows collect {when, allDay, node} for every row and sort once (all-day first, then by time, untimed 'Any time'/'Due' last) before returning; reuse the comparator eventsOn uses.
